spec: Appendix A A26 (owner-approved 2026-09-18, CANONICAL TEMPLATES: every plan is the owner's own Push, Pull and Legs — one list per kind, the same rows at every experience; experience changes SETS only, brand-new 3×8 · some 4×8 · experienced 5×8; no optional rows; the mobility closing block stays) · Flow 1 step 3 (Push · Pull · Legs; mobility block 2–3 holds ~5–10 min) · A1 (PPL at every frequency) · A21.1 (full gym for everyone; the equipment TAG stays) · T005
gapNotes: A26 (owner-approved 2026-09-18) REPLACES every earlier list: the 15 kind × experience lists of A21.1 (and with them Flow 1 step 3's 4 at 3×10 · 6 incl. barbell lifts, and G7's 5 at 3×8–10) are gone; templates nest kind → exercise ids and nothing else. A row may REPEAT an exercise (Pull carries the cable rope curl three times, between the pulls, as the owner trains it) — rows are addressed by `order`, never by exercise id.

A26: `namedSwaps` records the swaps the owner named for a row, keyed by the row's exercise id. SwapFinder is unchanged (tiers swapGroup → pattern → region): a row with a named swap keeps between swapCandidatesMin and swapCandidatesMax OTHER members in its swap group, so the finder stops at the group tier and offers every one of them — the named swaps included — at every experience and under any name order. check-seeds asserts it.

A26: Full-Body A/B has not been generated since A1; its six lists and its two closing blocks went with the rest. workoutNames and split keep the two kinds because a legacy plan may still carry them; split.fullBodyMaxTrainingDays stays validated, unused by generation.
A26 — PARKED OWNER IDEA, NOT BUILT: a dynamic warm-up block opening each workout. Nothing here prepares for it (Appendix C).

A1 (owner-directed 2026-09-08): every generated plan is Push day · Pull day · Leg day at every frequency 1–7 — workouts rotate, the next one is the one after the last completed rotation workout, so balance is automatic over any 3k completed workouts.

A21.1 (owner-approved 2026-09-17): no equipment tiers; the per-exercise equipment tag stays. Exercise ids are stable across every rename (A26 renamed six rows to the owner's words; couch-stretch, doorway-pec-stretch and doorframe-row kept their ids under gym names), so every saved plan and session keeps resolving its rows.
